::: {.research-lead}
We study why tissues age unevenly.
:::

::: {.research-intro}
Damage that is never fully repaired leaves behind small aging niches, making aging a non-linear, mosaic process. We follow these niches, the cells that change fate inside them, and the diseases they lead to.
:::

![](assets/research/research_overview.webp){fig-alt="Overview of our research: human bodies become mosaic with age; zooming into an aged liver reveals a senescent niche; inside one cell of that niche, chromatin and RNA isoforms, protein signaling and metabolic rewiring lead to one of seven fates, and these fates feed back on the tissue."}
